nl: Create etc/systemd/system/mailer.service following the layout of orders.service: Description=Mail sender, After=network.target, User=orders, ExecStart=/opt/mailer/bin/mailer --config /etc/mailer.toml, Restart=on-failure, WantedBy=multi-user.target.

etc/systemd/system/mailer.service.text:
[Unit]
Description=Mail sender
After=network.target

[Service]
User=orders
ExecStart=/opt/mailer/bin/mailer --config /etc/mailer.toml
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

reference_bash:
mkdir -p 'etc/systemd/system'
printf '%s' '[Unit]
Description=Mail sender
After=network.target

[Service]
User=orders
ExecStart=/opt/mailer/bin/mailer --config /etc/mailer.toml
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
' > 'etc/systemd/system/mailer.service'

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'etc/systemd/system' | Out-Null
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'etc/systemd/system/mailer.service'), '[Unit]
Description=Mail sender
After=network.target

[Service]

ExecStart=/opt/mailer/bin/mailer --config /etc/mailer.toml

')
